goal.text: Keep a running inventory of everything she has demonstrated on this walkthrough so she can tell the people following her what she never got to.

turns.text: Keep a running list for me as I go — what did I just open, and with which hands?

trigger.detail: gaze left the first unit under the sink for the one beside it

expected_answer.text: You opened the pair of cabinet doors beneath the kitchen sink using both hands, then let go of the right one to peek inside.

turns.text: First one done — did I close it properly?

trigger.detail: both doors swung shut and she straightened up

expected_answer.text: You did. You straightened up and pushed both of them shut together, then backed off with your hands clasped.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm — actually, how long was that whole thing open for?

trigger.detail: user escalates a backchannel into a turn mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Roughly twenty seconds — you swung it open just after six and had it shut again by twenty-six.

turns.text: Next one. This door I'm pulling — both hands again?

trigger.detail: hallway closet door pulled open

expected_answer.text: No, just your right this time; you reached for the hallway closet on your own and kept the other hand free to gesture.

turns.text: Actually — hold that. Is it worth me showing them inside, or just the front of it?

trigger.detail: user cuts in to redirect the demonstration

expected_answer.text: Worth showing — you've already swung it wide and you're gesturing at the inside with your free hand.

turns.text: And the route — how did I get from there to this doorway?

trigger.detail: halted at the bathroom entrance and eased the door open

expected_answer.text: You shut it, pivoted right, walked the length of the bedroom hallway, then stopped and turned right again to face this one.

turns.text: We're in. How many goes have I had at that switch?

trigger.detail: sustained fiddling with the light switch

expected_answer.text: Three touches so far — one on the way in, one when you came back to it, and you're on it again now.

turns.text: Wait — did I shut the hall one?

trigger.detail: focus left the unit she had been at for the door and ceiling

expected_answer.text: Yes. You pulled it closed with both hands before you walked on down the hallway.

turns.text: Good. And right now — where have my eyes gone?

trigger.detail: head tips back immediately after the previous reply starts

expected_answer.text: Up to the ceiling light; you tipped your head back when you stepped away from the door.

turns.text: Sorry, one more bit of admin — file all of this under the bathroom, not the hall.

trigger.detail: bookkeeping instruction, no scene trigger

expected_answer.text: Done. Everything since you crossed the threshold is filed under the bathroom.

turns.text: Right, count that flush for me. Once or twice?

trigger.detail: focus left the door for the unit she had been opening

expected_answer.text: Twice. You leaned in and pressed the handle, half straightened, then reached down and pressed it a second time.

turns.text: That room's logged. Anything left on in there?

trigger.detail: light switched off and she steps out

expected_answer.text: No — you hit the switch off on your way out, so the room is dark behind you.

turns.text: No no — scratch that, I'm going back in for another look.

trigger.detail: user reverses the close-out mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Understood — I'll keep it open on the list until you come out again.

turns.text: There — that's it. Which hand did that one?

trigger.detail: flushed again after re-entering and relighting the room

expected_answer.text: Your left this time — that's the swap; both of the earlier presses were right-handed.

turns.text: Oh — by the way, is there a plant anywhere in here?

trigger.detail: gaze moved off the unit onto the greenery by the basin

expected_answer.text: There is — a potted one on the ledge to your right, in frame on and off since you walked in.

turns.text: You've gone quiet. What am I scanning for?

trigger.detail: long stretch of looking about with no manipulation

expected_answer.text: You've been sweeping the room left to right and keep settling back on your companions in the doorway.

turns.text: And without me turning round — is that drawer shut?

trigger.detail: user probes an object outside current gaze

expected_answer.text: It is. You pushed it back in and tapped the edge of the frame before you straightened up.

turns.text: So why do I keep ducking down by that thing?

trigger.detail: repeated crouches on either side of the pan

expected_answer.text: You're inspecting around the base of the toilet — right-hand corner first, then round to the left-hand side.

turns.text: Right, we're out of there for good now. Tick it off?

trigger.detail: the pan leaves view for the rest of the window

expected_answer.text: Ticked — light off, drawers closed, and you're through into the bedroom.

turns.text: How long have I been parked in front of this?

trigger.detail: focus left the unit behind her for the framed piece

expected_answer.text: Around fifteen seconds. You walked up at about two hundred and ten, pointed twice, and now you've a hand on it.

turns.text: Speaking of which, who's sat behind me right now?

trigger.detail: user probes the space behind her while she faces the wall

expected_answer.text: Your two companions are on the bed behind you — you glanced back at them a moment ago.

turns.text: Okay — what have I just twisted over here?

trigger.detail: reached the bedside unit and turned the shade's dial

expected_answer.text: The dial on the bedside lampshade; you leaned over the little table and turned it with your right hand.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm — and the potted thing, is that still with us?

trigger.detail: backchannel escalates into a callback question

expected_answer.text: No. That dropped out of shot back in the bathroom and hasn't been seen since about a hundred and ninety.

turns.text: Right, nearly done. What am I pulling on now?

trigger.detail: both hands took the blind cord at the window

expected_answer.text: The cord on the blinds — both hands on it, drawing it down in front of the window.

turns.text: Turned about again. What's got me now?

trigger.detail: focus left the framed piece for the bed and the unit past it

expected_answer.text: You're facing the bed and tracking along it towards the drawers in the bedside unit.

turns.text: Hang on — have I had those open at all yet?

trigger.detail: user cuts in before the reply finishes

expected_answer.text: No, that's the first time — in this room you'd only touched the wardrobe and the lamp before now.

turns.text: Anyway — back to the running list. Anything on it I still haven't shown them?

trigger.detail: lull in activity; user returns to the standing goal

expected_answer.text: Only two things: the kitchen beyond that one cupboard, and what's actually inside the closet out in the hall.

turns.text: Okay — last one. What's caught me out here?

trigger.detail: focus left the bed for the window and the view beyond

expected_answer.text: The view outside; you turned to the window beside you a second ago and you're still on it.
